tasks.label: Build and Push Docker Image
tasks.command: cd ./docker; docker buildx build -t ghcr.io/security-tools-alliance/reconpoint:reconpoint-${image}-${version} -t ghcr.io/security-tools-alliance/reconpoint:reconpoint-${image}-latest -f ./${image}/Dockerfile ./${image} && docker push ghcr.io/security-tools-alliance/reconpoint:reconpoint-${image}-${version} && if [ "${input:isLatest}" = "true" ]; then docker push ghcr.io/security-tools-alliance/reconpoint:reconpoint-${image}-latest; fi
